SELECT C.COMMUNITY_NO, C.COMMUNITY_TITLE, C.VIEW_COUNT, C.CREATED_AT, C.GOAL_DATE, C.SUCCESS_TYPE, U.USER_NICKNAME AS USER_NICKNAME, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR( REGEXP_REPLACE( REPLACE(C.COMMUNITY_CONTENT, ' ', ''), '<[^>]*>' , '' ), 100, 1 ) AS COMMUNITY_CONTENT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_BOARD_LIKE BL WHERE BL.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO) AS LIKE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_TBL CT WHERE CT.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO ) AS COMMENT_COUNT, (SELECT I.IMG_PATH FROM COMMUNITY_IMG_TBL I WHERE I.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS THUMBNAIL FROM COMMUNITY_TBL C JOIN USER_TBL U ON C.USER_NO = U.USER_NO
NVL(C.DELETE_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND C.COMMUNITY_TYPE = 'success'
AND C.SUCCESS_TYPE = #{category}
AND C.COMMUNITY_TITLE LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'
ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_TBL
NVL(DELETE_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND COMMUNITY_TYPE = 'success'
AND SUCCESS_TYPE = #{category}
AND COMMUNITY_TITLE LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.COMMUNITY_NO, C.COMMUNITY_TITLE, C.COMMUNITY_TYPE, C.SUCCESS_TYPE, C.VIEW_COUNT, C.CREATED_AT, U.USER_NICKNAME, GREATEST(C.VIEW_COUNT, NVL(CT.CNT, 0)) AS POPULAR_BOARD, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_BOARD_LIKE BL WHERE BL.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO) AS LIKE_COUNT, NVL(CT.CNT, 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM COMMUNITY_TBL C JOIN USER_TBL U ON C.USER_NO = U.USER_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COMMUNITY_NO, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM COMMENT_TBL GROUP BY COMMUNITY_NO ) CT ON CT.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO WHERE C.COMMUNITY_TYPE = 'success' AND NVL(C.DELETE_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY POPULAR_BOARD DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.COMMUNITY_NO, C.COMMUNITY_TITLE, C.COMMUNITY_TYPE, C.SUCCESS_TYPE, C.VIEW_COUNT, C.CREATED_AT, U.USER_NICKNAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_TBL CT WHERE CT.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO ) AS COMMENT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_BOARD_LIKE BL WHERE BL.COMMUNITY_NO = C.COMMUNITY_NO) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM COMMUNITY_TBL C JOIN USER_TBL U ON C.USER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE C.COMMUNITY_TYPE = 'success' AND NVL(C.DELETE_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY COMMENT_COUNT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
